_comment: Per-action corrections, keyed by action id (the card id plus its A/B slot, which is exactly how the publisher's sheets label them). Source for every entry below is the publisher's championship-legal English parts lists (v1.02). Those come from the game company, so they outrank both the community database that generated cards.json and an older card scan. Ranges of 0 on a Firing or Projectile action are the community data simply not recording a range at all.

173_B._note: Fire Control Planning. cards.json says 0; OTTO read 6 off the printed card 2026-08-18 — the scan mistook the 6 for a 0. A 0 would have confined a "within Range" aura to its own Large Grid.

ZHDR-304_A._source: Printed English card scan assets/cards/en/ZHDR-304.webp, read 2026-08-13. The action had NO English at all.

description.en: · When performing a Command Movement, may consume 1 additional Command Token and -2 Movement to drag 1 adjacent Ally Mech or Ally Drone.

ZHDR-304_B._source: Printed English card scan assets/cards/en/ZHDR-304.webp, read 2026-08-13. No English at all, and the Chinese in cards.json is the OLDER variant: it omits the -2 Movement and says 友军单位 (ally unit) where the card says Ally Mech or Ally Drone. The card-level description carries a second, newer Chinese line that does match the print.

ZHDR-204_A._note: N305 Eagle I "Misty Eagle", Feature Reduction. The rule is only in the printed text — the community data gave this action no gameRules at all, so the engine had nothing structured to read. Written here rather than in cards.json because that file is regenerated from the community bundle and hand edits are wiped (see data/cards_extra.json). Two things about this entry are unlike every other structured aura in the set: the passive prints NO 光环/Aura bullet, and its effect kind is deliberately NOT low_profile — it is measured against the ENEMY shooter and applies to whatever that shooter targets, so filing it under the ally-side kind would have handed the buff to the opposing player.

ZHDR-206_A._note: Rules DO remove a Low Profile Token (Stabilize System, Tactics 277, entering Optical Camouflage) but every one keys on shape:'hexagon', never on the name, so Silence is none of their business. What is missing is the ONE removal Silence exists to prevent: no Movement, facing change or Scan takes the Token off. types.ts already promises that removal; whoever implements it gates it on Silence and on this aura denying it.

, Dynamic Perception. The community data gave this Passive no gameRules, so the rule was only in the printed line 范围内敌军单位的所有动作失去静默. Written here and not in cards.json, which is regenerated from the community bundle and would lose the edit (see data/cards_extra.json). Shaped after ZHDR-202_B and 072_A; like ZHDR-204_A it prints no 光环/Aura bullet, which is why no generator ever produced it. The structured effect is what makes the card readable at all: units.ts matches any Chinese action text containing 静默, and this action's own text contains 失去静默, so a text-driven reading would hand the Eagle the keyword it exists to strip. Range needs no correction — cards.json already prints 3. NOTE the effect is only half of rulebook 4.12. Silence is two things: the Action does not break Optical Camouflage, and the unit KEEPS its Low Profile Token while performing it. Only the first half bites, and NOT because Low Profile is unmodelled — it is a full status (types.ts, green decay; printed faces in data.ts TOKEN_PRINT; counted by the attack helper for the [Eye]->[Dodge] swap). The reason is narrower: nothing in app/src ever REMOVES a lowProfile Token as a consequence of a rule, so a keyword that protects the Token from removal has nothing to protect it from yet. The types.ts status note already promises that removal ("Maneuvering, including a facing-only change, removes the token"), so whoever writes it must gate it on Silence and on this aura denying it.
